chunks: Even then you deny the Judgement.
ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Ad-Din' refer to in the context of Surah Al-Infitar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Ad-Din' here is interpreted not merely as religion but as the comprehensive system of divine accountability and recompense, linking directly to the concept of *Ma'ad* (resurrection). This verse underscores the disbelievers' rejection of the Hereafter as the root cause of their moral corruption, a theme frequently elaborated in the commentaries of Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni.
